title: Environment file points at a default channel
description: environment.yml declares an environment channel list that names `defaults` or `nodefaults`. A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads an environment channel list that names `defaults` or `nodefaults`.
remediation: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix an environment channel list that names `defaults` or `nodefaults`.
limitation: It matches an environment channel list that names `defaults` or `nodefaults` in the parsed environment.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
